acceptanceCriteria: A pull request that adds a refusal code no spec names fails CI.

CI runs the Makefile's documentation checks that are gate steps (spec-requirements, requirement-definitions, traceability-tests, decision-numbers, line-citations, error-code-ownership) on every pull request.
body: Found while preparing 0.8.1 (decision 0381 item 11). PR #160 added 26 dogfood change/check/seal refusal and step codes that no spec named, so `make error-code-ownership-check`, a GATE_STEPS entry, failed on main from 7739f60 on. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs only go test, go vet and go-archive-gate, so no PR check saw it; the release gate would have. PR #165 adds the owning spec section (DCW-V0-020).
title: ci: pull requests do not run the documentation gate steps, so unowned error codes reached main
